decisions.reason: The supplied October 7 publication date falls within September 16–October 15. Accept as an author-reported computational experiment and methodological case study. The new contribution is applying a constrained code-editing loop to photovoltaic segmentation, with a frozen evaluator and split, 24 experiments per campaign, and a 3,600-second training limit per trial—not a one-hour total search budget ([saved text, §§1–3](data/assets/a007976d7a6dcb8c99635a7e/22bcded05aecba83c6a4594604bdc843c3061c7ccdf19d4be43c9ea27beaec4f/text.txt)). Researchers choose the architecture, data, metric and acceptance rule; the agent searches within those gates. The hardware-dependent retention patterns are useful for students deciding what to rerun locally, but model and hardware are confounded. Single-seed evaluations, one held-out test evaluation, no declared-space tuner baseline, and unestimated variation limit performance conclusions; the reference comparison also differs in compute and augmentation (§§3.1–4). Explicitly disclose numeric inconsistencies: Table 3 gives 0.836 versus 0.833 and 0.801, implying differences of 0.003 and 0.035, whereas §3.2 states 0.002 and 0.034; Table 1's Loop C delta is 0.120 although its rounded endpoints imply 0.121. Do not use these unresolved comparisons to establish superiority, lower cost or faster execution. The repository is linked in the abstract, but its contents and independent replication are not supplied. This is the authors' own preprint evidence; the supplied text contains no conflict-of-interest disclosure, which does not establish absence of conflicts.

The supplied September 29 publication date is in-window. Accept narrowly as a practitioner account contrasting physical and computational experiment verification, not as validated performance evidence. The useful material is the founders' account of furnace drift and telemetry (s00295–s00346, 850.38–953.78 seconds), replicates and noise-triggered reruns (s00362–s00373, 980.88–1005.08), and recording hypotheses, predictions, execution and reruns (s00861–s00875, 2068.26–2099.88; [saved transcript](data/assets/ade5c65097bf35b3d1cb467e/5a82503b8b0e7e873cc96ddaa5b89b9957e647009d50cff4f549b940594dfeef/segments.json)). These support an editorial inference that students should preserve execution provenance and inspect anomalous measurements. Novelty is the recent operational account; dates of the underlying lab events are unspecified. Preserve the autonomy qualification: precursor suggestions coexist with human involvement, handling can be robotic or human, and modality selection began with human intuition (s00743–s00758, s00774–s00785, s01170–s01186). The introduction's thousands-per-day capability framing at s00023–s00024 is qualified by the later future scaling language at s00748–s00750; actual throughput is not established. Debugging and simulation-validation anecdotes at s00890–s00932 lack inspectable logs, controls and independent researcher validation. Likewise, the cost reduction at s01104–s01116 is an unaudited founder claim, not demonstrated savings. Commercial interests are explicit in customer systems and retained IP (s01206–s01223, 2848.96–2894.64). Other Periodic founder interviews share that interest and cannot corroborate this account independently. The automatic transcript remains provisional; no audio listening is claimed.

The supplied October 5 publication date is in-window. Accept for the proposed intervention and evidence scrutiny: preserve the workspace, clear conversation context, branch under a budget and select by an external grader. This directly informs students' experiment scheduling; it changes inference-time search, not model weights ([saved text, §§2, 4 and 7](data/assets/b1f8d59a9e19a86e11b1f913/d65818cf27d705500dbc6ee16a00aa24ff79c55f10cb82e034d39e559cbc1994/text.txt)). The authors report matched token-credit baselines across 13 tasks and fork-only/flush-only ablations on 11 (§§5.1–5.3). Credits meter model tokens, not total hardware expenditure or elapsed time (Appendix B), so equal credits cannot establish lower total cost or faster execution. Explicitly disclose unresolved reporting conflicts: §5.1 says five runs per task and a universal 33%/66% schedule, while Appendix B gives four tinyCIFAR seeds and Appendix G reports some 50% schedules; §6.1 describes a 71% trigger. Table 1 and Appendix A disagree on Borden-inv means (64.62/85.85 versus 59.92/80.24), without a supplied reconciliation. Do not use the headline 66.0%/44.4% normalized-score gains to establish best-result claims until clarified; Table 1 also shows LWE-rec favoring the serial baseline. The idea-basin interpretation depends on an LLM generating specifications and judging their similarity; held-out triplets and a second embedding validate agreement with that judge, not independent scientific ground truth (Appendix F). Human review is a safeguard, not evidence that bias occurred. Researchers choose tasks, graders and schedules. Full prompt bodies are missing from the supplied Appendix I, hardware details are insufficient for complete cost reproduction, and no independent replication is supplied. Microsoft Research internship affiliation is disclosed in the acknowledgments; this is an interested author evaluation, not external validation.

The supplied September 23 UTC publication date is in-window. Accept only as researcher guidance for making delegated experiments inspectable: provenance for data and methods (s00289–s00312, 969.4–1044.32 seconds), sharing variable definitions and R/Python code (s00795–s00811, 2460.23–2498.03), and allocating time for plans and methodological review before data collection (s01090–s01100, 3276.07–3305.83; [saved transcript](data/assets/e351f88c9bbc63c033f1aab7/de7f1e6f75069d6e82b0732ba9729ef01809dd0621fa585ccb3cb1690c97dcc9/segments.json)). Applying that advice to agent-run experiments is an editorial inference; this episode neither demonstrates autonomous execution nor measures improved agent outcomes. Its contribution is a recent researcher perspective, not a new experimental result. The referenced report was presented in June (s00055–s00059), and its September publication is only anticipated at s00568; no original report text or accessible report link is supplied, so do not claim its publication or independently validate its findings. Preserve the practical qualification that sharing requires planning and appropriate consent (s00773–s00794). The earlier 'not time-consuming' phrasing at s00752 is qualified by explicit extra-time advice at s01076–s01100; do not promise effortless reproducibility. Automatic transcription is provisional, and ambiguous wording should not support accusations or substantive conclusions without audio checking. One guest discusses her own co-authored report and the other is introduced as editor-in-chief of the journal she recommends (s00055–s00059; s00650–s00653; s01029–s01039): disclose these professional interests. This supplies a distinct researcher perspective, not replication of any accepted agent study.
